purpose: Published external matched-panel test of state-dimension-dependent ecological memory using Northeast USA SeagrassNet Zostera marina monitoring.

independence_boundary.claim: external published matched panel, not fully independent monitoring observations
independence_boundary.reason: Some Northeast USA SeagrassNet sites overlap monitoring networks represented in the already-opened NPS panel.

source.title: Northeast USA SeagrassNet Zm percent cover
source.protocol: SeagrassNet; three fixed 50-m transects per site; twelve permanent/randomized quadrat positions per transect depending source implementation

hypothesis.primary: Under one sampling design, previous-year state should improve prediction for both coarse presence and quantitative cover, while history older than one year should add more robust information to coarse presence than to quantitative cover.
hypothesis.matched_unit: same site/transect/quadrat-or-equivalent repeated sampling unit and target year
hypothesis.history_operator: same exponential all-prior-state operator for both state dimensions
hypothesis.tau_reason: pre-frozen from the earlier Tampa binary recorded-state analysis before this external matched-panel candidate is opened
hypothesis.lag1_prediction: lag-1 should add information beyond stable sampling-unit identity and target year for both dimensions
hypothesis.older_history_prediction: tau=10 older history should satisfy the predeclared support rule for coarse state but not quantitative cover

no_rescue: Do not call this panel fully independent of NPS monitoring.
Do not choose tau after response access.
Do not switch to a different response dimension after seeing results.
Do not drop adverse sites or target years based on outcomes.
